reason_detail: apartment_id and zone_id were free text chosen by the model, then compared by string equality. A1 wrote APT-EAST / ZONE-EAST-RESIDENTIAL; A2 wrote APT-01 / BEDROOM_WING_NORTH. Those may denote the same topology at different granularity, so 0% field agreement is a measurement artefact, not a finding about the agents. The run is preserved because it is the evidence that exposed the defect.
benchmark_seal: INTACT — no MEASURER figure was compared against this run
what_run_0_does_establish: Both agents returned schema-valid output over all 36 opaque spaces.
Neither agent returned a geometry field; zero geometry mutation attempts.
semantic_label agreed on 36/36 — same-model blind reproducibility, NOT independent correctness.
Seven scope disagreements (terraces, voids, maid block, iron room, shaft) are real and were carried into Run 1 unchanged.
what_run_0_does_not_establish: No accuracy claim of any kind. The benchmark was never opened.
apartment_id / zone_id agreement is uninterpretable under the defective schema.
trade_relevance agreement (12/36) measured an LLM decision that has since been moved to E27.
